skill.name: convex-improve-convex-plugin
skill.description: Submit an approved coding-session transcript to the Convex review service and summarize findings that can improve Convex onboarding tools.
skill.summary: Review a coding session to identify improvements for Convex quickstarts, skills, scripts, and components.
skill.author: get-convex

security_audit.summary: The skill downloads a remote helper and immediately executes it with Bash, so the critical pipe-to-shell finding is confirmed. It also uploads coding-session transcripts after consent, creating a separate high-severity privacy and data-disclosure risk.

remediation.issue: The workflow executes a remotely downloaded script without integrity verification.
remediation.suggestion: Distribute a versioned helper, pin its release and checksum, verify the checksum locally, and execute only the verified file.

remediation.issue: The workflow submits coding-session transcripts to an external review service.
remediation.suggestion: Show the destination, data scope, retention policy, and redacted preview before each upload, then require explicit confirmation.

finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 14 instructs the agent to invoke curl and Bash. This is genuine external command execution, even though the static pattern label references Ruby backticks.
SKILL.md line 14 pipes an unpinned remote response directly into Bash without signature or checksum verification. A compromised endpoint or network path could execute arbitrary commands.

content.value_statement: Convex onboarding problems can remain hidden inside coding-session transcripts. This skill submits an approved transcript for analysis and summarizes actionable system improvements.
actual_capabilities: Requests explicit sharing consent when the helper reports that no preference exists.
Submits a discovered Claude or Codex transcript to the configured review service.
Passes a one-line application idea as context for the review.
Monitors submission and completion markers returned by the helper.
Summarizes severe findings, suggested fixes, affected targets, and successful patterns.
Focuses review output on Convex runbooks, bootstrap scripts, skills, and components.
limitations: Requires access to the remote helper and review endpoint.
Cannot review a session when no supported transcript file is available.
Relies on the downloaded helper to redact secrets before upload.
Does not provide end-user product feedback or inspect application behavior independently.

use_cases.title: Diagnose onboarding friction
use_cases.description: Review a completed Convex setup session and identify unclear instructions, stalled steps, and tooling failures.

use_cases.title: Improve agent instructions
use_cases.description: Extract recurring agent difficulties and suggested fixes for skills, runbooks, and bootstrap scripts.

use_cases.title: Prioritize developer experience work
use_cases.description: Summarize severe workflow problems and successful patterns from an approved session review.

prompt_templates.title: Review this session
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this Convex coding session. Ask for my sharing choice before submitting any transcript.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer wants a basic post-mortem after completing a quickstart.

prompt_templates.title: Find setup friction
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this session for ambiguous setup instructions, stalled agent behavior, and tooling failures. Summarize the most severe findings and suggested fixes.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer encountered problems during project setup.

prompt_templates.title: Assess a quickstart workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Submit this approved session with the application idea: [IDEA]. Group findings by runbook, bootstrap script, skill, or component.
prompt_templates.scenario: A maintainer needs targeted feedback about a specific quickstart.

prompt_templates.title: Produce a prioritized improvement brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this approved Convex session. Rank findings by severity, name each affected target, propose concrete fixes, and conclude with successful patterns worth preserving.
prompt_templates.scenario: A developer experience team needs an actionable improvement brief.

output_examples.input: Review my approved session for quickstart problems.
output: High: The bootstrap instructions did not explain the required environment value.
Suggested fix: Validate the value early and show a direct recovery step.
Win: The deployment verification step completed without intervention.

output_examples.output: The review identified one severe runbook ambiguity and two tooling failures. It recommends clearer prerequisites, earlier validation, and preserving the successful verification flow.

best_practices: Review the sharing destination and transcript scope before granting consent.
Use a concise application idea that accurately describes the reviewed session.
Present findings by severity, affected target, suggested fix, and successful pattern.
anti_patterns: Do not submit a transcript before the user explicitly chooses a consent option.
Do not assume secret redaction removes proprietary code, personal data, or sensitive context.
Do not present system-improvement findings as end-user product feedback.

faq.question: What does this skill review?
faq.answer: It reviews a supported coding-session transcript for problems and successes in Convex quickstarts, runbooks, scripts, skills, and components.

faq.question: Does it upload my transcript?
faq.answer: Yes. After consent, the helper submits the current transcript to an external review endpoint.

faq.question: Will it ask before sharing?
faq.answer: The workflow requires an explicit Always, Just this once, or Never choice when no saved preference exists.

faq.question: Are secrets removed?
faq.answer: The skill states that the helper redacts keys and tokens. You should still inspect the data scope before submission.

faq.question: What happens when no transcript is found?
faq.answer: The helper reports REVIEW_NO_TRANSCRIPT, and the skill informs the user that no Claude or Codex transcript was available.

faq.question: What results does the skill provide?
faq.answer: It summarizes severe findings with affected targets and suggested fixes, followed by successful patterns from the session.
